ex.s: On our final morning in the house, we took a break from the mind-bending, never-ending work of packing to sit down for that last breakfast.
ex.t: 在老房子里的最后一个早晨，我们从令人头疼、没完没了的打包工作中歇下来，坐下来吃最后一顿早餐。

ex.s: He was thrilled to be doing the comedy that he always felt he should do, but even during his last few years, he always had a sense of curiosity, wondering what new role or challenge might be just around the corner.
ex.t: 他为自己能出演一直觉得应该演的喜剧而兴奋，但即使在生命的最后几年，他也始终保持着好奇心，想知道下一个新的角色或挑战可能就在眼前。

defs.def: most recently 最新；最近；上一次

ex.s: "Big change requires big ideas." he said in a speech last month, referring broadly to the need to improve road safety.
ex.t: "大变革需要大构想，"他在上个月的一次演讲中说，泛指改善道路安全的需要。

ex.s: Last winter when I went here again, they had a big separate house to raise dozens of chicken.
ex.t: 去年冬天我再去了一次，他们有了一间独立的大屋，养了几十只鸡。

ex.s: Has it been a while since your last ihff to a public library?
ex.t: 你上一次去公共图书馆是不是已经有一阵子了？

ex.s: The last few years have been exciting because I've been following my heart to do what I love.
ex.t: 最近几年很令人兴奋因为我一直在追随内心做我喜欢的事。

ex.s: In fact, the last time there were pandas in the Netherlands was in 1987.
ex.t: 事实上，荷兰上一次有大熊猫是在1987年。

ex.s: When was the last time you took on a tough choice?
ex.t: 你上一次面对艰难抉择是什么时候？

ex.t: 我上一次为打电话而使用电话亭，是……2006年。

ex.s: in the future，the team hopes to develop a version of the technology that can be sprayed onto plant leaves in a one-off treatment that would last the plant’s lifetime.
ex.t: 未来，该团队希望开发一种技术版本，可以一次性喷洒到植物叶片上，效果持续植物一生。

defs.def: the person or thing that comes or happens after all other similar people or things 最后来的人（或发生的事）

ex.s: That’s exactly what is happening in small neighborhoods around the country from Orange County, California, where 22 measles cases were reported this month, to Brooklyn, N.Y., where a 17-year-old caused an outbreak last year.
ex.t: 这正是全国各个小社区正在发生的情况，从本月报告了22例麻疹的加州奥兰治县，到去年一名17岁少年引发疫情的纽约布鲁克林。

ex.t: 从最后一段可以推断出这种化学物质可能

ex.t: 我上次见他是几个月前。

ex.s: Last year the Foundation reported that nearly 60% of 7- to 12-year-olds said they felt tired during the day, and 15% said they had fallen asleep at school.
ex.t: 去年，该基金会报告称，近60%的7至12岁儿童说他们白天感到疲倦，15%说他们在学校里睡着了。

ex.s: I last saw him a few months ago.
ex.t: 我上次见他是几个月前。

ex.s: As it has been many years since I last used one, I should hardly be surprised that there are no longer any public telephones near my house.
ex.t: 距离我上次使用电话亭已经很多年了，所以我几乎不惊讶我家附近已经没有任何公用电话了。

ex.s: I used to afraid of insects, but last Friday’s biology class make a big change in me.
ex.t: 我过去害怕昆虫，但上周五的生物课让我发生了很大的改变。

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: Analyses of a language database also confirmed that there was a global change in the sound of world languages after the Neolithic age, with the use of “f” and “v” increasing remarkably during the last few thousand years.
ex.t: 对一个语言数据库的分析也证实，新石器时代之后世界语言的声音发生了全球性的变化，"f"和"v"的使用在近几千年显著增加。

defs.def: the only remaining part or items of sth 仅剩下的部分（或事项）

ex.s: The car shaped some of the most lasting aspects of American culture: the roadside diner, the billboard, the motel, even the hamburger.
ex.t: 汽车塑造了美国文化中一些最持久的方面：路边餐厅、广告牌、汽车旅馆，甚至汉堡包。

defs.def: to continue for a particular period of time 不用于进行时

ex.s: I was stupid with cold, but I couldn’t remember the last time I’d felt so happy.
ex.t: 我冻得傻乎乎的，但我记不起上次感到这么快乐是什么时候了。

defs.def: to continue to exist or to function well 继续存在；持续起作用；持久

ex.s: It makes what is learned more precise and longer lasting.
ex.t: 它使所学的东西更加精确且更持久。

ex.s: 53    Also, sometimes pre-anger does not have to do with a lasting condition, but rather a temporary state before a triggering event has occurred.
ex.t: 53    此外，有时“前愤怒”与持久状态无关，而是触发事件发生前的暂时状态。

ex.s: may have lasting value
ex.t: 可能具有持久的价值

ex.s: Greatness comes from a lasting desire to explore.
ex.t: 伟大来自持久的探索欲望。

ex.s: Their research also suggests how we may build lasting memories over time even though the synapses become thinner.
ex.t: 他们的研究也揭示了我们如何能在突触变细的情况下随着时间建立持久的记忆。

ex.s: A Seem unlikely to last.
ex.t: A 似乎不太可能持久。

ex.s: That love for philosophy lasted until I got to college.
ex.t: 那份对哲学的热爱一直持续到我上大学。

ex.s: That lasted about ten minutes.
ex.t: 那持续了约十分钟。

ex.s: How long does Potty about Potter last?
ex.t: Potty about Potter持续多久？

ex.s: Why did Paul and the author have a lasting friendship?
ex.t: 为什么保罗和作者之间有着持久的友谊？

ex.s: Climate change is a continuing process, so Norphel’s ice reserves will not last forever.
ex.t: 气候变化是一个持续的过程，所以诺费尔的冰储备不会永远持续下去。

ex.s: This style of farming lasted for quite a long time.
ex.t: 这种耕作方式持续了相当长的时间。

defs.def: to survive sth or manage to stay in the same situation, despite difficulties （在困境等中）坚持下去；超逾（困境等）
